title: HPL3/Level Design/Terrain Height Map
wikitext:
= HeightMap mode =

This mode allows the user to modify the terrain geometry. A set of 3 different brushes is made available for doing so.

[[File:terrain_mode_heightmap.png]]

Raise/Lower brush: this brush just adds or substracts height to the area being painted.
Flatten brush: this brush raises or lowers the affected area to a given height.
Smooth brush: this brush applies a smoothing effect (thus flattening sharp spikes and such) to the area being painted.

One can also use the Terrain generation window to set up a randomly generated heightmap. Heightmaps can also be exported and imported.
